description: The canonical records every AgentFrontier implementation emits. Operations in a source definition map their results onto these fields; anything that does not map lands in the record's `properties` map. Hierarchy level values (for example `database`, `schema`, `folder`) are added to every record by the engine and are not listed here.

types.string: text; numbers and booleans are converted with their plain text form
types.long: 64-bit integer; numeric text is parsed, anything else becomes null
types.double: floating point; numeric text is parsed
types.boolean: true/false; also accepts t/f, yes/no, y/n, on/off, 1/0 (any case)
types.list: ordered list; arrays are kept, text is split on commas and trimmed, a single scalar becomes a one-item list

aspects.metadata: Structure: the source, its containers, datasets, fields, keys, indexes and routines.
aspects.lineage: Which datasets (and fields) are derived from which.
aspects.governance: Who can do what: principals, grants, access policies and tags.
aspects.statistics: Profiles of the data: null fractions, distinct counts, widths.
aspects.usage: How the data is used: query history and access logs.
aspects.data: Rows of the data itself (samples and read-only queries).

source.description: The system as a whole. One per session.

container.description: A level of the source's hierarchy: database, schema, catalog, bucket, folder, project, namespace. `level` names which.

dataset.description: Something that holds records: table, view, file, index, collection, API endpoint, topic.

field.description: A column of a table or a property of a document. Nested properties use a dotted `name` and set `parent`.

constraint.description: Primary key, unique key, foreign key or check. A foreign key's target is `refDataset` plus `ref<Level>` for each hierarchy level (refDatabase, refSchema, ...).

lineage.description: `dataset` (downstream, in the scope's location) is derived from `upstreamDataset` (located by `upstream<Level>`, for example upstreamSchema). Field-level edges also set `field` and `upstreamField`.

principal.description: User, role, group or service account.

grant.description: A privilege a principal holds on an object.

policy.description: Row access, masking, retention or other access rule.

tag.description: A tag or classification attached to an object.

statistic.description: Profile of a dataset or field. `distinctCount` below zero means a fraction of the row count (PostgreSQL convention).
